arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طه
transliteration: Taa-Haa

translations.en.sahih: Ta, Ha.
translations.en.pickthall: Ta. Ha.
translations.en.yusufali: Ta-Ha.
translations.id.indonesian: Thaahaa.

arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
transliteration: Maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Qur-aana litashqaaa

translations.en.sahih: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
translations.en.pickthall: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
translations.en.yusufali: We have not sent down the Qur'an to thee to be (an occasion) for thy distress,
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tidak menurunkan Al Quran ini kepadamu agar kamu menjadi susah;

arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
transliteration: Illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa

translations.en.sahih: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
translations.en.pickthall: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,
translations.en.yusufali: But only as an admonition to those who fear (Allah),-
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi sebagai peringatan bagi orang yang takut (kepada Allah),

arabic: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
transliteration: Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa

translations.en.sahih: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
translations.en.pickthall: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,
translations.en.yusufali: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the heavens on high.
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu diturunkan dari Allah yang menciptakan bumi dan langit yang tinggi.

arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
transliteration: Ar-Rahmaanu 'alal 'Arshis tawaa

translations.en.sahih: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
translations.en.pickthall: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) Most Gracious is firmly established on the throne (of authority).
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah. Yang bersemayam di atas 'Arsy.

arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
transliteration: Lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa

translations.en.sahih: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.
translations.en.yusufali: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and on earth, and all between them, and all beneath the soil.
translations.id.indonesian: Kepunyaan-Nya-lah semua yang ada di langit, semua yang di bumi, semua yang di antara keduanya dan semua yang di bawah tanah.

arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
transliteration: Wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa

translations.en.sahih: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
translations.en.pickthall: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
translations.en.yusufali: If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jika kamu mengeraskan ucapanmu, maka sesungguhnya Dia mengetahui rahasia dan yang lebih tersembunyi.

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
transliteration: Allaahu laaa ilasha illaa Huwa lahul Asmaaa'ul Husnaa

translations.en.sahih: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
translations.en.pickthall: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.
translations.en.yusufali: Allah! there is no god but He! To Him belong the most Beautiful Names.
translations.id.indonesian: Dialah Allah, tidak ada Tuhan (yang berhak disembah) melainkan Dia. Dia mempunyai al asmaaul husna (nama-nama yang baik),

arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa hal ataaka hadeesu Moosa

translations.en.sahih: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
translations.en.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?
translations.en.yusufali: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah telah sampai kepadamu kisah Musa?

arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
transliteration: Iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa

translations.en.sahih: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
translations.en.pickthall: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, he saw a fire: So he said to his family, "Tarry ye; I perceive a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."
translations.id.indonesian: Ketika ia melihat api, lalu berkatalah ia kepada keluarganya: "Tinggallah kamu (di sini), sesungguhnya aku melihat api, mudah-mudahan aku dapat membawa sedikit daripadanya kepadamu atau aku akan mendapat petunjuk di tempat api itu".

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
transliteration: Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa Moosaa

translations.en.sahih: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
translations.en.pickthall: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!
translations.en.yusufali: But when he came to the fire, a voice was heard: "O Moses!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka ketika ia datang ke tempat api itu ia dipanggil: "Hai Musa.

arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
transliteration: Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.
translations.en.yusufali: "Verily I am thy Lord! therefore (in My presence) put off thy shoes: thou art in the sacred valley Tuwa.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Aku inilah Tuhanmu, maka tanggalkanlah kedua terompahmu; sesungguhnya kamu berada dilembah yang suci, Thuwa.

arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa

translations.en.sahih: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
translations.en.pickthall: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
translations.en.yusufali: "I have chosen thee: listen, then, to the inspiration (sent to thee).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Aku telah memilih kamu, maka dengarkanlah apa yang akan diwahyukan (kepadamu).

arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
transliteration: Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
translations.en.yusufali: "Verily, I am Allah: There is no god but I: So serve thou Me (only), and establish regular prayer for celebrating My praise.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Aku ini adalah Allah, tidak ada Tuhan (yang hak) selain Aku, maka sembahlah Aku dan dirikanlah shalat untuk mengingat Aku.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
transliteration: Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).
translations.en.yusufali: "Verily the Hour is coming - My design is to keep it hidden - for every soul to receive its reward by the measure of its Endeavour.
translations.id.indonesian: Segungguhnya hari kiamat itu akan datang Aku merahasiakan (waktunya) agar supaya tiap-tiap diri itu dibalas dengan apa yang ia usahakan.

arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
transliteration: Falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa

translations.en.sahih: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
translations.en.yusufali: "Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish!"..
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sekali-kali janganlah kamu dipalingkan daripadanya oleh orang yang tidak beriman kepadanya dan oleh orang yang mengikuti hawa nafsunya, yang menyebabkan kamu jadi binasa".

arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa Moosaa

translations.en.sahih: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
translations.en.pickthall: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?
translations.en.yusufali: "And what is that in the right hand, O Moses?"
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah itu yang di tangan kananmu, hai Musa?

arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
translations.en.yusufali: He said, "It is my rod: on it I lean; with it I beat down fodder for my flocks; and in it I find other uses."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Ini adalah tongkatku, aku bertelekan padanya, dan aku pukul (daun) dengannya untuk kambingku, dan bagiku ada lagi keperluan yang lain padanya".

arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala alqihaa yaa Moosaa

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said, "Throw it, O Moses!"
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Lemparkanlah ia, hai Musa!"

arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
transliteration: Fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa

translations.en.sahih: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
translations.en.pickthall: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.
translations.en.yusufali: He threw it, and behold! It was a snake, active in motion.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu dilemparkannyalah tongkat itu, maka tiba-tiba ia menjadi seekor ular yang merayap dengan cepat.

arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said, "Seize it, and fear not: We shall return it at once to its former condition"..
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Peganglah ia dan jangan takut, Kami akan mengembalikannya kepada keadaannya semula,

arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
transliteration: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa

translations.en.sahih: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
translations.en.pickthall: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.
translations.en.yusufali: "Now draw thy hand close to thy side: It shall come forth white (and shining), without harm (or stain),- as another Sign,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan kepitkanlah tanganmu ke ketiakmu, niscaya ia ke luar menjadi putih cemerlang tanpa cacad, sebagai mukjizat yang lain (pula),

arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
transliteration: Linuriyaka min Aayaatinal Kubra

translations.en.sahih: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
translations.en.pickthall: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,
translations.en.yusufali: "In order that We may show thee (two) of our Greater Signs.
translations.id.indonesian: untuk Kami perlihatkan kepadamu sebahagian dari tanda-tanda kekuasaan Kami yang sangat besar,

arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
transliteration: Izhab ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa

translations.en.sahih: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
translations.en.pickthall: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
translations.en.yusufali: "Go thou to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds."
translations.id.indonesian: Pergilah kepada Fir'aun; sesungguhnya ia telah melampaui batas".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
transliteration: Qaala Rabbish rah lee sadree

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "O my Lord! expand me my breast;
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Ya Tuhanku, lapangkanlah untukku dadaku,

arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
transliteration: Wa yassir leee amree

translations.en.sahih: And ease for me my task
translations.en.pickthall: And ease my task for me;
translations.en.yusufali: "Ease my task for me;
translations.id.indonesian: dan mudahkanlah untukku urusanku,

arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
transliteration: Wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee

translations.en.sahih: And untie the knot from my tongue
translations.en.pickthall: And loose a knot from my tongue,
translations.en.yusufali: "And remove the impediment from my speech,
translations.id.indonesian: dan lepaskanlah kekakuan dari lidahku,

arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
transliteration: Yafqahoo qawlee

translations.en.sahih: That they may understand my speech.
translations.en.pickthall: That they may understand my saying.
translations.en.yusufali: "So they may understand what I say:
translations.id.indonesian: supaya mereka mengerti perkataanku,

arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
transliteration: Waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee

translations.en.sahih: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
translations.en.pickthall: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
translations.en.yusufali: "And give me a Minister from my family,
translations.id.indonesian: dan jadikanlah untukku seorang pembantu dari keluargaku,

arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
transliteration: Haaroona akhee

translations.en.sahih: Aaron, my brother.
translations.en.pickthall: Aaron, my brother.
translations.en.yusufali: "Aaron, my brother;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) Harun, saudaraku,

arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
transliteration: Ushdud biheee azree

translations.en.sahih: Increase through him my strength
translations.en.pickthall: Confirm my strength with him
translations.en.yusufali: "Add to my strength through him,
translations.id.indonesian: teguhkanlah dengan dia kekuatanku,

arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
transliteration: Wa ashrik hu feee amree

translations.en.sahih: And let him share my task
translations.en.pickthall: And let him share my task,
translations.en.yusufali: "And make him share my task:
translations.id.indonesian: dan jadikankanlah dia sekutu dalam urusanku,

arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
transliteration: Kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa

translations.en.sahih: That we may exalt You much
translations.en.pickthall: That we may glorify Thee much
translations.en.yusufali: "That we may celebrate Thy praise without stint,
translations.id.indonesian: supaya kami banyak bertasbih kepada Engkau,

arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
transliteration: Wa nazkuraka kaseeraa

translations.en.sahih: And remember You much.
translations.en.pickthall: And much remember Thee.
translations.en.yusufali: "And remember Thee without stint:
translations.id.indonesian: dan banyak mengingat Engkau.

arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
transliteration: Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.
translations.en.yusufali: "For Thou art He that (ever) regardeth us."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Engkau adalah Maha Melihat (keadaan) kami".

arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa Moosaa

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Granted is thy prayer, O Moses!"
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Sesungguhnya telah diperkenankan permintaanmu, hai Musa".

arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa

translations.en.sahih: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
translations.en.pickthall: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,
translations.en.yusufali: "And indeed We conferred a favour on thee another time (before).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah memberi nikmat kepadamu pada kali yang lain,

arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
transliteration: Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa

translations.en.sahih: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
translations.en.pickthall: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,
translations.en.yusufali: "Behold! We sent to thy mother, by inspiration, the message:
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu ketika Kami mengilhamkan kepada ibumu suatu yang diilhamkan,

arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
transliteration: Aniqzifeehi fit Taabooti faqzifeehi fil yammi fal yul qihil yammu bis saahili yaakhuzhu 'aduwwul lee wa 'aduwwul lah; wa alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatam minnee wa litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
translations.en.pickthall: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,
translations.en.yusufali: "'Throw (the child) into the chest, and throw (the chest) into the river: the river will cast him up on the bank, and he will be taken up by one who is an enemy to Me and an enemy to him': But I cast (the garment of) love over thee from Me: and (this) in order that thou mayest be reared under Mine eye.
translations.id.indonesian: Yaitu: "Letakkanlah ia (Musa) didalam peti, kemudian lemparkanlah ia ke sungai (Nil), maka pasti sungai itu membawanya ke tepi, supaya diambil oleh (Fir'aun) musuh-Ku dan musuhnya. Dan Aku telah melimpahkan kepadamu kasih sayang yang datang dari-Ku; dan supaya kamu diasuh di bawah pengawasan-Ku,

arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa mai yakfuluhoo faraja 'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzan; wa qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadariny yaa Moosa

translations.en.sahih: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
translations.en.pickthall: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,
translations.en.yusufali: "Behold! thy sister goeth forth and saith, 'shall I show you one who will nurse and rear the (child)?' So We brought thee back to thy mother, that her eye might be cooled and she should not grieve. Then thou didst slay a man, but We saved thee from trouble, and We tried thee in various ways. Then didst thou tarry a number of years with the people of Midian. Then didst thou come hither as ordained, O Moses!
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) ketika saudaramu yang perempuan berjalan, lalu ia berkata kepada (keluarga Fir'aun): "Bolehkah saya menunjukkan kepadamu orang yang akan memeliharanya?" Maka Kami mengembalikanmu kepada ibumu, agar senang hatinya dan tidak berduka cita. Dan kamu pernah membunuh seorang manusia, lalu Kami selamatkan kamu dari kesusahan dan Kami telah mencobamu dengan beberapa cobaan; maka kamu tinggal beberapa tahun diantara penduduk Madyan, kemudian kamu datang menurut waktu yang ditetapkan hai Musa,

arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
transliteration: Wastana' tuka linafsee

translations.en.sahih: And I produced you for Myself.
translations.en.pickthall: And I have attached thee to Myself.
translations.en.yusufali: "And I have prepared thee for Myself (for service)"..
translations.id.indonesian: dan Aku telah memilihmu untuk diri-Ku.

arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
transliteration: Izhab anta wa akhooka bi Aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee zikree

translations.en.sahih: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
translations.en.pickthall: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.
translations.en.yusufali: "Go, thou and thy brother, with My Signs, and slacken not, either of you, in keeping Me in remembrance.
translations.id.indonesian: Pergilah kamu beserta saudaramu dengan membawa ayat-ayat-Ku, dan janganlah kamu berdua lalai dalam mengingat-Ku;

arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
transliteration: Izhabaaa ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa

translations.en.sahih: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
translations.en.pickthall: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
translations.en.yusufali: "Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds;
translations.id.indonesian: Pergilah kamu berdua kepada Fir'aun, sesungguhnya dia telah melampaui batas;

arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
transliteration: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa

translations.en.sahih: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."
translations.en.pickthall: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear.
translations.en.yusufali: "But speak to him mildly; perchance he may take warning or fear (Allah)."
translations.id.indonesian: maka berbicaralah kamu berdua kepadanya dengan kata-kata yang lemah lembut, mudah-mudahan ia ingat atau takut".

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
transliteration: Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant.
translations.en.yusufali: They (Moses and Aaron) said: "Our Lord! We fear lest he hasten with insolence against us, or lest he transgress all bounds."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkatalah mereka berdua: "Ya Tuhan kami, sesungguhnya kami khawatir bahwa ia segera menyiksa kami atau akan bertambah melampaui batas".

arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Fear not: for I am with you: I hear and see (everything).
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Janganlah kamu berdua khawatir, sesungguhnya Aku beserta kamu berdua, Aku mendengar dan melihat".

arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
transliteration: Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela wa laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa

translations.en.sahih: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
translations.en.pickthall: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.
translations.en.yusufali: "So go ye both to him, and say, 'Verily we are messengers sent by thy Lord: Send forth, therefore, the Children of Israel with us, and afflict them not: with a Sign, indeed, have we come from thy Lord! and peace to all who follow guidance!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka datanglah kamu berdua kepadanya (Fir'aun) dan katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya kami berdua adalah utusan Tuhanmu, maka lepaskanlah Bani Israil bersama kami dan janganlah kamu menyiksa mereka. Sesungguhnya kami telah datang kepadamu dengan membawa bukti (atas kerasulan kami) dari Tuhanmu. Dan keselamatan itu dilimpahkan kepada orang yang mengikuti petunjuk.

arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
transliteration: Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz zaba wa tawalla

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.
translations.en.yusufali: "'Verily it has been revealed to us that the Penalty (awaits) those who reject and turn away.'"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya telah diwahyukan kepada kami bahwa siksa itu (ditimpakan) atas orang-orang yang mendustakan dan berpaling.

arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala famar Rabbu kumaa yaa Moosa

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses?
translations.en.yusufali: (When this message was delivered), (Pharaoh) said: "Who, then, O Moses, is the Lord of you two?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Fir'aun: "Maka siapakah Tuhanmu berdua, hai Musa?.

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each (created) thing its form and nature, and further, gave (it) guidance."
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata: "Tuhan kami ialah (Tuhan) yang telah memberikan kepada tiap-tiap sesuatu bentuk kejadiannya, kemudian memberinya petunjuk.

arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala famaa baalul quroonil oolaa

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: What then is the state of the generations of old?
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "What then is the condition of previous generations?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Fir'aun: "Maka bagaimanakah keadaan umat-umat yang dahulu?"

arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
transliteration: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee wa laa yansaa

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth,
translations.en.yusufali: He replied: "The knowledge of that is with my Lord, duly recorded: my Lord never errs, nor forgets,-
translations.id.indonesian: Musa menjawab: "Pengetahuan tentang itu ada di sisi Tuhanku, di dalam sebuah kitab, Tuhan kami tidak akan salah dan tidak (pula) lupa;

arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa salaka lakum feehaa subulanw wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta

translations.en.sahih: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
translations.en.pickthall: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation,
translations.en.yusufali: "He Who has, made for you the earth like a carpet spread out; has enabled you to go about therein by roads (and channels); and has sent down water from the sky." With it have We produced diverse pairs of plants each separate from the others.
translations.id.indonesian: Yang telah menjadikan bagimu bumi sebagai hamparan dan Yang telah menjadikan bagimu di bumi itu jalan-ja]an, dan menurunkan dari langit air hujan. Maka Kami tumbuhkan dengan air hujan itu berjenis-jenis dari tumbuh-tumbuhan yang bermacam-macam.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
transliteration: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulin nuhaa

translations.en.sahih: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.
translations.en.yusufali: Eat (for yourselves) and pasture your cattle: verily, in this are Signs for men endued with understanding.
translations.id.indonesian: Makanlah dan gembalakanlah binatang-binatangmu. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu, terdapat tanda-tanda kekuasaan Allah bagi orang-orang yang berakal.

arabic: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
transliteration: Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa

translations.en.sahih: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
translations.en.pickthall: Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time.
translations.en.yusufali: From the (earth) did We create you, and into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you out once again.
translations.id.indonesian: Dari bumi (tanah) itulah Kami menjadikan kamu dan kepadanya Kami akan mengembalikan kamu dan daripadanya Kami akan mengeluarkan kamu pada kali yang lain,

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
transliteration: Wa laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz zaba wa abaa

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
translations.en.pickthall: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.
translations.en.yusufali: And We showed Pharaoh all Our Signs, but he did reject and refuse.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah perlihatkan kepadanya (Fir'aun) tanda-tanda kekuasaan Kami semuanya maka ia mendustakan dan enggan (menerima kebenaran).

arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa Moosa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses?
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Hast thou come to drive us out of our land with thy magic, O Moses?
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Fir'aun: "Adakah kamu datang kepada kami untuk mengusir kami dari negeri kami (ini) dengan sihirmu, hai Musa?

arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
transliteration: Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa wa bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu wa laaa anta makaanan suwaa

translations.en.sahih: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
translations.en.pickthall: But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both).
translations.en.yusufali: "But we can surely produce magic to match thine! So make a tryst between us and thee, which we shall not fail to keep - neither we nor thou - in a place where both shall have even chances."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamipun pasti akan mendatangkan (pula) kepadamu sihir semacam itu, maka buatlah suatu waktu untuk pertemuan antara kami dan kamu, yang kami tidak akan menyalahinya dan tidak (pula) kamu di suatu tempat yang pertengahan (letaknya).

arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
transliteration: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati wa ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.
translations.en.yusufali: Moses said: "Your tryst is the Day of the Festival, and let the people be assembled when the sun is well up."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Waktu untuk pertemuan (kami dengan) kamu itu ialah di hari raya dan hendaklah dikumpulkan manusia pada waktu matahari sepenggalahan naik".

arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
transliteration: Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa

translations.en.sahih: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
translations.en.pickthall: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).
translations.en.yusufali: So Pharaoh withdrew: He concerted his plan, and then came (back).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Fir'aun meninggalkan (tempat itu), lalu mengatur tipu dayanya, kemudian dia datang.

arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala lahum Moosaa wailakum laa taftaroo 'alal laahi kaziban fa yus hitakum bi 'azaab, wa qad khaaba manif taraa

translations.en.sahih: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
translations.en.pickthall: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.
translations.en.yusufali: Moses said to him: Woe to you! Forge not ye a lie against Allah, lest He destroy you (at once) utterly by chastisement: the forger must suffer frustration!"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa kepada mereka: "Celakalah kamu, janganlah kamu mengada-adakan kedustaan terhadap Allah, maka Dia membinasakan kamu dengan siksa". Dan sesungguhnya telah merugi orang yang mengada-adakan kedustaan.

arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
transliteration: Fatanaaza'ooo amrahum bainahum wa asarrun najwaa

translations.en.sahih: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
translations.en.pickthall: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret.
translations.en.yusufali: So they disputed, one with another, over their affair, but they kept their talk secret.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka berbantah-bantahan tentang urusan mereka di antara mereka dan mereka merahasiakan percakapan (mereka).

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
transliteration: Qaalooo in haaazaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ai yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wa yazhabaa bitareeqatikumul muslaa

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "These two are certainly (expert) magicians: their object is to drive you out from your land with their magic, and to do away with your most cherished institutions.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya dua orang ini adalah benar-benar ahli sihir yang hendak mengusir kamu dari negeri kamu dengan sihirnya dan hendak melenyapkan kedudukan kamu yang utama.

arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
transliteration: Fa ajmi'oo kaidakum summma'too saffaa; wa qad aflahal yawma manis ta'laa

translations.en.sahih: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
translations.en.pickthall: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.
translations.en.yusufali: "Therefore concert your plan, and then assemble in (serried) ranks: He wins (all along) today who gains the upper hand."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka himpunkanlah segala daya (sihir) kamu sekalian, kemudian datanglah dengan berbaris. dan sesungguhnya beruntunglah oran yang menang pada hari ini.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
transliteration: Qaaloo yaa Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya wa immaaa an nakoona awala man alqaa

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw?
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "O Moses! whether wilt thou that thou throw (first) or that we be the first to throw?"
translations.id.indonesian: (Setelah mereka berkumpul) mereka berkata: "Hai Musa (pilihlah), apakah kamu yang melemparkan (dahulu) atau kamikah orang yang mula-mula melemparkan?"

arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala bal alqoo fa izaa hibaaluhum wa 'isiyyuhum yuhaiyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran.
translations.en.yusufali: He said, "Nay, throw ye first!" Then behold their ropes and their rods-so it seemed to him on account of their magic - began to be in lively motion!
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Silahkan kamu sekalian melemparkan". Maka tiba-tiba tali-tali dan tongkat-tongkat mereka, terbayang kepada Musa seakan-akan ia merayap cepat, lantaran sihir mereka.

arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ
transliteration: Fa awjasa fee nafsihee kheefatam Moosa

translations.en.sahih: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
translations.en.pickthall: And Moses conceived a fear in his mind.
translations.en.yusufali: So Moses conceived in his mind a (sort of) fear.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Musa merasa takut dalam hatinya.

arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
transliteration: Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal a'laa

translations.en.sahih: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
translations.en.pickthall: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher.
translations.en.yusufali: We said: "Fear not! for thou hast indeed the upper hand:
translations.id.indonesian: Kami berkata: "janganlah kamu takut, sesungguhnya kamulah yang paling unggul (menang).

arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
transliteration: Wa alqi maa fee yamee nika talqaf maa sana'oo; innamaa sana'oo kaidu saahir; wa laa yuflihus saahiru haisu ataa

translations.en.sahih: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
translations.en.pickthall: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.
translations.en.yusufali: "Throw that which is in thy right hand: Quickly will it swallow up that which they have faked what they have faked is but a magician's trick: and the magician thrives not, (no matter) where he goes."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan lemparkanlah apa yang ada ditangan kananmu, niscaya ia akan menelan apa yang mereka perbuat. "Sesungguhnya apa yang mereka perbuat itu adalah tipu daya tukang sihir (belaka). Dan tidak akan menang tukang sihir itu, dari mana saja ia datang".

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Fa ulqiyas saharatu sujjadan qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbi Haaroona wa Moosa

translations.en.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
translations.en.pickthall: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.
translations.en.yusufali: So the magicians were thrown down to prostration: they said, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses".
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu tukang-tukang sihir itu tersungkur dengan bersujud, seraya berkata: "Kami telah percaya kepada Tuhan Harun dan Musa".

arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum; innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'allama kumus sihra fala uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibannakum fee juzoo'in nakhli wa lata'lamunna aiyunaaa ashaddu 'azaabanw wa abqaa

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment.
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? Surely this must be your leader, who has taught you magic! be sure I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will have you crucified on trunks of palm-trees: so shall ye know for certain, which of us can give the more severe and the more lasting punishment!"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Fir'aun: "Apakah kamu telah beriman kepadanya (Musa) sebelum aku memberi izin kepadamu sekalian. Sesungguhnya ia adalah pemimpinmu yang mengajarkan sihir kepadamu sekalian. Maka sesungguhnya aku akan memotong tangan dan kaki kamu sekalian dengan bersilang secara bertimbal balik, dan sesungguhnya aku akan menyalib kamu sekalian pada pangkal pohon kurma dan sesungguhnya kamu akan mengetahui siapa di antara kita yang lebih pedih dan lebih kekal siksanya".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
transliteration: Qaaloo lan nu'siraka 'alaa maa jaaa'anaa minal baiyinaati wallazee fataranaa faqdi maaa anta qaad; innamaa taqdee haazihil hayaatad dunyaa

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Never shall we regard thee as more than the Clear Signs that have come to us, or than Him Who created us! so decree whatever thou desirest to decree: for thou canst only decree (touching) the life of this world.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Kami sekali-kali tidak akan mengutamakan kamu daripada bukti-bukti yang nyata (mukjizat), yang telah datang kepada kami dan daripada Tuhan yang telah menciptakan kami; maka putuskanlah apa yang hendak kamu putuskan. Sesungguhnya kamu hanya akan dapat memutuskan pada kehidupan di dunia ini saja.

arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
transliteration: Innaaa aamannaa bi Rabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wa maaa akrahtanaa 'alaihi minas sihr; wallaahu khairunw waabqaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting.
translations.en.yusufali: "For us, we have believed in our Lord: may He forgive us our faults, and the magic to which thou didst compel us: for Allah is Best and Most Abiding."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kami telah beriman kepada Tuhan kami, agar Dia mengampuni kesalahan-kesalahan kami dan sihir yang telah kamu paksakan kepada kami melakukannya. Dan Allah lebih baik (pahala-Nya) dan lebih kekal (azab-Nya)".

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
transliteration: Innahoo mai yaati Rabbahoo mujriman fa inna lahoo Jahannama laa yamotu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily he who comes to his Lord as a sinner (at Judgment),- for him is Hell: therein shall he neither die nor live.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya barangsiapa datang kepada Tuhannya dalam keadaan berdosa, maka sesungguhnya baginya neraka Jahannam. Ia tidak mati di dalamnya dan tidak (pula) hidup.

arabic: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
transliteration: Wa mai yaatihee mu'minan qad 'amilas saalihaati fa ulaaa'ika lahumud dara jaatul 'ulaa

translations.en.sahih: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
translations.en.pickthall: But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations;
translations.en.yusufali: But such as come to Him as Believers who have worked righteous deeds,- for them are ranks exalted,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan barangsiapa datang kepada Tuhannya dalam keadaan beriman, lagi sungguh-sungguh telah beramal saleh, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang memperoleh tempat-tempat yang tinggi (mulia),

arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
transliteration: Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; wa zaalika jazaaa'ua man tazakka

translations.en.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
translations.en.pickthall: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.
translations.en.yusufali: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which flow rivers: they will dwell therein for aye: such is the reward of those who purify themselves (from evil).
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) surga 'Adn yang mengalir sungai-sungai di bawahnya, mereka kekal di dalamnya. Dan itu adalah balasan bagi orang yang bersih (dari kekafiran dan kemaksiatan).

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
transliteration: Wa laqad awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakanw wa laa takhshaa

translations.en.sahih: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea).
translations.en.yusufali: We sent an inspiration to Moses: "Travel by night with My servants, and strike a dry path for them through the sea, without fear of being overtaken (by Pharaoh) and without (any other) fear."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami wahyukan kepada Musa: "Pergilah kamu dengan hamba-hamba-Ku (Bani Israil) di malam hari, maka buatlah untuk mereka jalan yang kering dilaut itu, kamu tak usah khawatir akan tersusul dan tidak usah takut (akan tenggelam)".

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
transliteration: Fa atba'ahum Fir'awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal yammmi maa ghashi yahum

translations.en.sahih: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
translations.en.pickthall: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea.
translations.en.yusufali: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his forces, but the waters completely overwhelmed them and covered them up.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Fir'aun dengan bala tentaranya mengejar mereka, lalu mereka ditutup oleh laut yang menenggelamkan mereka.

arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
transliteration: wa adalla fir'awnu qawmahoo wa maa hadaa

translations.en.sahih: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
translations.en.pickthall: And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them.
translations.en.yusufali: Pharaoh led his people astray instead of leading them aright.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Fir'aun telah menyesatkan kaumnya dan tidak memberi petunjuk.

arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
transliteration: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eela qad anjainaakum min 'aduw wikum wa wa'adnaakum jaanibat Tooril aimana wa nazzalnaa 'alaikumul Manna was Salwaa

translations.en.sahih: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
translations.en.pickthall: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails,
translations.en.yusufali: O ye Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We made a Covenant with you on the right side of Mount (Sinai), and We sent down to you Manna and quails:
translations.id.indonesian: Hai Bani Israil, sesungguhnya Kami telah menyelamatkan kamu sekalian dari musuhmu, dan Kami telah mengadakan perjanjian dengan kamu sekalian (untuk munajat) di sebelah kanan gunung itu dan Kami telah menurunkan kepada kamu sekalian manna dan salwa.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
transliteration: Kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa laa tatghaw feehi fa yahilla 'alaikum ghadabee wa mai yahlil 'alaihi ghadabee faqad hawaa

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.
translations.en.yusufali: (Saying): "Eat of the good things We have provided for your sustenance, but commit no excess therein, lest My Wrath should justly descend on you: and those on whom descends My Wrath do perish indeed!
translations.id.indonesian: Makanlah di antara rezeki yang baik yang telah Kami berikan kepadamu, dan janganlah melampaui batas padanya, yang menyebabkan kemurkaan-Ku menimpamu. Dan barangsiapa ditimpa oleh kemurkaan-Ku, maka sesungguhnya binasalah ia.

arabic: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
transliteration: Wa innee la Ghaffaarul liman taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan summah tadaa

translations.en.sahih: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.
translations.en.yusufali: "But, without doubt, I am (also) He that forgives again and again, to those who repent, believe, and do right, who,- in fine, are ready to receive true guidance."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Aku Maha Pengampun bagi orang yang bertaubat, beriman, beramal saleh, kemudian tetap di jalan yang benar.

arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Wa maaa a'jalaka 'an qawmika yaa Moosa

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
translations.en.pickthall: And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses?
translations.en.yusufali: (When Moses was up on the Mount, Allah said:) "What made thee hasten in advance of thy people, O Moses?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa kamu datang lebih cepat daripada kaummu, hai Musa?

arabic: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
transliteration: Qaala hum ulaaa'i 'alaaa asaree wa 'ajiltu ilaika Rabbi litardaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased.
translations.en.yusufali: He replied: "Behold, they are close on my footsteps: I hastened to thee, O my Lord, to please thee."
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata, Musa: "Itulah mereka sedang menyusuli aku dan aku bersegera kepada-Mu. Ya Tuhanku, agar supaya Engkau ridha (kepadaku)".

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
transliteration: Qaala fa innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba'dika wa adallahumus Saamiriyy

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "We have tested thy people in thy absence: the Samiri has led them astray."
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Maka sesungguhnya Kami telah menguji kaummu sesudah kamu tinggalkan, dan mereka telah disesatkan oleh Samiri.

arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
transliteration: Faraja's Moosaaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa; qaala yaa qawmi alam ya'idkum Rabbukum wa'dan hasanaa; afataala 'alaikumul 'ahdu am arattum ai yahilla 'alaikum ghadabum mir Rabbikum fa akhlaftum maw'idee

translations.en.sahih: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
translations.en.pickthall: Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me?
translations.en.yusufali: So Moses returned to his people in a state of indignation and sorrow. He said: "O my people! did not your Lord make a handsome promise to you? Did then the promise seem to you long (in coming)? Or did ye desire that Wrath should descend from your Lord on you, and so ye broke your promise to me?"
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Musa kembali kepada kaumnya dengan marah dan bersedih hati. Berkata Musa: "Hai kaumku, bukankah Tuhanmu telah menjanjikan kepadamu suatu janji yang baik? Maka apakah terasa lama masa yang berlalu itu bagimu atau kamu menghendaki agar kemurkaan dari Tuhanmu menimpamu, dan kamu melanggar perjanjianmu dengan aku?".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًۭا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
transliteration: Qaaloo maaa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinna wa laakinna hummilnaaa awzaaram min zeenatil qawmi faqazafnaahaa fakazaalika alqas Saamiriyy

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "We broke not the promise to thee, as far as lay in our power: but we were made to carry the weight of the ornaments of the (whole) people, and we threw them (into the fire), and that was what the Samiri suggested.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Kami sekali-kali tidak melanggar perjanjianmu dengan kemauan kami sendiri, tetapi kami disuruh membawa beban-beban dari perhiasan kaum itu, maka kami telah melemparkannya, dan demikian pula Samiri melemparkannya",

arabic: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
transliteration: Fa akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haazaaa ilaahukum wa ilaahu Moosaa fanasee

translations.en.sahih: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
translations.en.pickthall: Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten.
translations.en.yusufali: "Then he brought out (of the fire) before the (people) the image of a calf: It seemed to low: so they said: This is your god, and the god of Moses, but (Moses) has forgotten!"
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian Samiri mengeluarkan untuk mereka (dari lobang itu) anak lembu yang bertubuh dan bersuara, maka mereka berkata: "Inilah Tuhanmu dan Tuhan Musa, tetapi Musa telah lupa".

arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا
transliteration: Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilaihim qawlanw wa laa yamliku lahum darranw wa laa naf'aa

translations.en.sahih: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
translations.en.pickthall: See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use?
translations.en.yusufali: Could they not see that it could not return them a word (for answer), and that it had no power either to harm them or to do them good?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan bahwa patung anak lembu itu tidak dapat memberi jawaban kepada mereka, dan tidak dapat memberi kemudharatan kepada mereka dan tidak (pula) kemanfaatan?

arabic: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
transliteration: Wa laqad qaala lahum Haaroonu min qablu yaa qawmi innamaa futintum bihee wa inna Rabbakumur Rahmaanu fattabi'oonee wa atee'ooo amree

translations.en.sahih: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
translations.en.pickthall: And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order.
translations.en.yusufali: Aaron had already, before this said to them: "O my people! ye are being tested in this: for verily your Lord is (Allah) Most Gracious; so follow me and obey my command."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Harun telah berkata kepada mereka sebelumnya: "Hai kaumku, sesungguhnya kamu hanya diberi cobaan dengan anak lembu. itu dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu ialah (Tuhan) Yang Maha Pemurah, maka ikutilah aku dan taatilah perintahku".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
transliteration: Qaaloo lan nabraha 'alaihi 'aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilainaa Moosaa

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.
translations.en.yusufali: They had said: "We will not abandon this cult, but we will devote ourselves to it until Moses returns to us."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami akan tetap menyembah patung anak lembu ini, hingga Musa kembali kepada kami".

arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
transliteration: Qaala Yaa Haaroonu maa mana 'aka iz ra aitahum dallooo

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
translations.en.pickthall: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray,
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "O Aaron! what kept thee back, when thou sawest them going wrong,
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Hai Harun, apa yang menghalangi kamu ketika kamu melihat mereka telah sesat,

arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
transliteration: Allaa tattabi'ani afa'asaita amree

translations.en.sahih: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
translations.en.pickthall: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?
translations.en.yusufali: "From following me? Didst thou then disobey my order?"
translations.id.indonesian: (sehingga) kamu tidak mengikuti aku? Maka apakah kamu telah (sengaja) mendurhakai perintahku?"

arabic: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
transliteration: Qaala yabna'umma laa taakhuz bilihyatee wa laa biraasee innee khashetu an taqoola farraqta baina Baneee Israaa'eela wa lam tarqub qawlee

translations.en.sahih: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "
translations.en.pickthall: He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word.
translations.en.yusufali: (Aaron) replied: "O son of my mother! Seize (me) not by my beard nor by (the hair of) my head! Truly I feared lest thou shouldst say, 'Thou has caused a division among the children of Israel, and thou didst not respect my word!'"
translations.id.indonesian: Harun menjawab' "Hai putera ibuku, janganlah kamu pegang janggutku dan jangan (pula) kepalaku; sesungguhnya aku khawatir bahwa kamu akan berkata (kepadaku): "Kamu telah memecah antara Bani Israil dan kamu tidak memelihara amanatku".

arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ
transliteration: Qaala famaa khatbuka yaa Saamiriyy

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri?
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "What then is thy case, O Samiri?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Apakah yang mendorongmu (berbuat demikian) hai Samiri?"

arabic: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
transliteration: Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min asarir Rasooli fanabaztuhaa wa kazaalika sawwalat lee nafsee

translations.en.sahih: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.
translations.en.yusufali: He replied: "I saw what they saw not: so I took a handful (of dust) from the footprint of the Messenger, and threw it (into the calf): thus did my soul suggest to me."
translations.id.indonesian: Samiri menjawab: "Aku mengetahui sesuatu yang mereka tidak mengetahuinya, maka aku ambil segenggam dari jejak rasul lalu aku melemparkannya, dan demikianlah nafsuku membujukku".

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
transliteration: Qaala fazhab fa inna laka fil hayaati an taqoola laa misaasa wa inna laka maw'idal lan tukhlafahoo wanzur ilaaa ilaahikal lazee zalta 'alaihi 'aakifaa; lanuharriqannnahoo summa lanansifanahoo fil yammi nasfaa

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea.
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "Get thee gone! but thy (punishment) in this life will be that thou wilt say, 'touch me not'; and moreover (for a future penalty) thou hast a promise that will not fail: Now look at thy god, of whom thou hast become a devoted worshipper: We will certainly (melt) it in a blazing fire and scatter it broadcast in the sea!"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Pergilah kamu, maka sesungguhnya bagimu di dalam kehidupan di dunia ini (hanya dapat) mengatakan: "Janganlah menyentuh (aku)". Dan sesungguhnya bagimu hukuman (di akhirat) yang kamu sekali-kali tidak dapat menghindarinya, dan lihatlah tuhanmu itu yang kamu tetap menyembahnya. Sesungguhnya kami akan membakarnya, kemudian kami sungguh-sungguh akan menghamburkannya ke dalam laut (berupa abu yang berserakan).

arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا
transliteration: Innamaaa ilaahukkumul laahul lazee laa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wasi'a kulla shai'in ilmaa

translations.en.sahih: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
translations.en.pickthall: Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge.
translations.en.yusufali: But the god of you all is the One Allah: there is no god but He: all things He comprehends in His knowledge.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu hanyalah Allah, yang tidak ada Tuhan selain Dia. Pengetahuan-Nya meliputi segala sesuatu".

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًۭا
transliteration: Kazaalika naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'i maa qad sabaq; wa qad aatainaaka mil ladunnaa Zikraa

translations.en.sahih: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus do We relate to thee some stories of what happened before: for We have sent thee a Message from Our own Presence.
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah kami kisahkan kepadamu (Muhammad) sebagian kisah umat yang telah lalu, dan sesungguhnya telah Kami berikan kepadamu dari sisi Kami suatu peringatan (Al Quran).

arabic: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
transliteration: Man a'rada 'anhu, fa innahoo yahmilu Yawmal Qiyaamati wizraa

translations.en.sahih: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
translations.en.pickthall: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection,
translations.en.yusufali: If any do turn away therefrom, verily they will bear a burden on the Day of judgment;
translations.id.indonesian: Barangsiapa berpaling dari pada Al qur'an maka sesungguhnya ia akan memikul dosa yang besar di hari kiamat,

arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا
transliteration: Khaalideena feehi wa saaa'a lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati himlaa

translations.en.sahih: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
translations.en.pickthall: Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection,
translations.en.yusufali: They will abide in this (state): and grievous will the burden be to them on that Day,-
translations.id.indonesian: mereka kekal di dalam keadaan itu. Dan amat buruklah dosa itu sebagai beban bagi mereka di hari kiamat,

arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا
transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fissoori wa nahshurul mujrimeena Yawma 'izin zurqaa

translations.en.sahih: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
translations.en.pickthall: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),
translations.en.yusufali: The Day when the Trumpet will be sounded: that Day, We shall gather the sinful, blear-eyed (with terror).
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) di hari (yang di waktu itu) ditiup sangkakala dan Kami akan mengumpulkan pada hari itu orang-orang yang berdosa dengan muka yang biru muram;

arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًۭا
transliteration: Yatakhaafatoona bainahum il labistum illaa 'ashraa

translations.en.sahih: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
translations.en.pickthall: Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days).
translations.en.yusufali: In whispers will they consult each other: "Yet tarried not longer than ten (Days);
translations.id.indonesian: mereka berbisik-bisik di antara mereka: "Kamu tidak berdiam (di dunia) melainkan hanyalah sepuluh (hari)"

arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًۭا
transliteration: nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona iz yaqoolu amsaluhum tareeqatan illabistum illaa yawmaa

translations.en.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
translations.en.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day.
translations.en.yusufali: We know best what they will say, when their leader most eminent in conduct will say: "Ye tarried not longer than a day!"
translations.id.indonesian: Kami lebih mengetahui apa yang mereka katakan, ketika berkata orang yang paling lurus jalannya di antara mereka: "Kamu tidak berdiam (di dunia), melainkan hanyalah sehari saja".

arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا
transliteration: Wa yas'aloonaka 'anil jibaali faqul yansifuhaa Rabbee nasfaa

translations.en.sahih: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
translations.en.pickthall: They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust.
translations.en.yusufali: They ask thee concerning the Mountains: say, "My Lord will uproot them and scatter them as dust;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka bertanya kepadamu tentang gunung-gunung, maka katakanlah: "Tuhanku akan menghancurkannya (di hari kiamat) sehancur-hancurnya,

arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا
transliteration: Fa yazaruhaa qaa'an safsafaa

translations.en.sahih: And He will leave the earth a level plain;
translations.en.pickthall: And leave it as an empty plain,
translations.en.yusufali: "He will leave them as plains smooth and level;
translations.id.indonesian: maka Dia akan menjadikan (bekas) gunung-gunung itu datar sama sekali,

arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ أَمْتًۭا
transliteration: Laa taraa feehaa 'iwajanw wa laaa amtaa

translations.en.sahih: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness.
translations.en.yusufali: "Nothing crooked or curved wilt thou see in their place."
translations.id.indonesian: tidak ada sedikitpun kamu lihat padanya tempat yang rendah dan yang tinggi-tinggi.

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًۭا
transliteration: Yawma iziny yattabi'oonad daa'iya laa 'iwaja lahoo wa khasha'atil aswaatu lir Rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa

translations.en.sahih: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
translations.en.pickthall: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur.
translations.en.yusufali: On that Day will they follow the Caller (straight): no crookedness (can they show) him: all sounds shall humble themselves in the Presence of (Allah) Most Gracious: nothing shalt thou hear but the tramp of their feet (as they march).
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari itu manusia mengikuti (menuju kepada suara) penyeru dengan tidak berbelok-belok; dan merendahlah semua suara kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, maka kamu tidak mendengar kecuali bisikan saja.

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا
